detail.longDescription:
NCalc — Powerful Scientific Calculator, Graphing, and Converter

NCalc combines a natural-display scientific calculator, advanced math tools, a full graphing module (as 83/84 calculator), a large formula library, and a comprehensive unit and currency converter—designed for students, engineers, and anyone who loves math.

◉ Main Calculator Features
- Natural display: Enter expressions exactly as in textbooks—fractions, roots, exponents, and more—see results as written on paper.
- Keyboard layout: Matches popular models for familiarity and speed: 115 ES Plus, 991 ES Plus, 300 ES Plus, and 991 EX.
- Symbolic and numeric modes: Perform exact fraction calculation or evaluate numerically when needed.
- Arbitrary precision integers: Work with very large integers without losing accuracy.
- Output types: Choose from fraction, mixed fraction, decimal, repeating decimal, degrees/minutes/seconds, and polar coordinates.
- Angle units: Degree, radian, and gradian (grade).
- Decimal formatter: Display numbers in normal, engineering, engineering SI, scientific, or fixed formats.
- Calculation history: Review and reuse past calculations with ease.
- Copy and paste support for fast data entry and sharing.

◉ Algebra, Calculus, and Core Math
- Algebra calculation: Expansion, factorization, simplification, and more.
- Calculus calculator: Derivatives, integrals, and limits of expressions.
- Complex number calculation: Arithmetic, polar/rectangular conversion, exponential, logarithm, powers, roots, and full trigonometric functions.

◉ Equations and Inequalities
- Equation solver: Solve general equations, plus dedicated solvers for quadratic, cubic, and quartic equations.
- System of equations solver: Solve systems with 2, 3, or 4 variables.
- Inequality solvers: Quadratic, cubic, and quartic inequalities with interval-based solutions.

◉ Matrices and Vectors
- Operations: Addition, subtraction, multiplication for matrices and vectors.
- Advanced tools: Determinant, inverse, transpose, rank, eigenvalues, and eigenvectors.

◉ Statistics and Distributions
- Statistical calculation: Descriptive stats and regression calculation (including a regression plotter).
- Distribution calculation: Normal distribution, binomial distribution, Poisson distribution, t-distribution, chi-square distribution, and F-distribution.

◉ Number Bases and Formats
- Base N calculation: Effortlessly switch between binary, octal, decimal, and hexadecimal, with arithmetic in each base.

◉ Tables, Variables, and Custom Functions
- Table Generator: Generate value tables based on any expression and range.
- Calculator variables: Store values and reuse them across calculations.
- User-defined functions: Create your own functions to streamline repetitive work.
- Built-in constants: A rich set of mathematical and physical constants.

◉ Formulas
- Extensive formula collection: Math and Physics formulas, clearly categorized—ideal for secondary school, high school, and university students.

◉ Unit Converter
- Currency Converter
- 1000+ unit conversions

◉ Graphing as 83, 84 calculator
- Cartesian functions, implicit plots, polar, and parametric.
- Tracing, roots, intersections, extrema, derivative, and integral evaluations on graphs.

◉ Auto-renewing subscription
You may purchase an auto-renewing subscription through an In-App Purchase.
• Auto-renewable subscription
• Your subscription will be charged to your AppStore account at confirmation of purchase and will automatically renew (at the duration selected) unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Current subscription may not be cancelled during the active subscription period; however, you can manage your subscription and/or turn off auto-renewal by visiting your AppStore Account Settings after purchase
• Privacy policy and terms of use: https://ncalc-app.web.app/terms-of-services.html
